title: aspidium cochleatum
intro: Aspidium cochleatum, commonly known as the Maidenhair Fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium cochleatum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
